title: Reconcile preserved Codex BOOT-04 research with the finalized decision worksheet
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/developer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Local intake found uncommitted Codex BOOT-04 research from 2026-10-07/08: 41 untracked files plus stash@{0} edits to 15 tracked files based on 5819142. Compared it against the finalized BOOT-04 worksheet, ADR0007 and ADR0008 merged at 3687bed. The Director chose to reconcile, keeping the finalized decisions authoritative and the Codex data as evidence.

Restore unchanged as evidence: Codex records CHG-20261007-005 and CHG-20261008-001/002; RUN-20261007-063..067 and RUN-20261008-001..009 with logs (failures preserved); cost/source fixtures; duels.ink observations. Restore the October 7/8 plans and the proposed ADR file 0007-single-host-beta-proposal.md with only a dated supersession note. Classify them historical (observations: evidence).

Restore the non-conflicting stash edits: the corrected hosted-CI sentence in DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW, the F-STAGING planned feature, and the FEATURES/WORKSPACE_QUALIFICATION/README entries. Reword them to the final decisions. Hand-merge the conflicting AGENTS, docs/README, vision/README, infra/README, backlog, decision register, documentation map and handoff onto main's versions. Do not carry over the Codex proposal files added as impact sources on current documents.

Adopt Codex findings into the worksheet: Director inputs (primarily North America; up to 50 concurrent invited-beta players; cost tiers before a ceiling); duels.ink reference facts; the remote-runtime prerequisite (APP_ENV=local enforced in packages/service-runtime/src/lifecycle.ts); the 50-player growth fixture; build/restore separation; and a section listing preserved research. Add matching notes to ADR0007 and D02/D03, make validation/boot-04.md the current BOOT-04 evidence document, and rewrite the handoff.
Local Dev Container (Node 24.21.0/pnpm 10.33.0) intake RUN-20261010-004 doctor and RUN-20261010-005 read-only db:check passed. Final verify/test:documentation runs are referenced in verification.

Final local Dev Container checks: RUN-20261010-006 pnpm verify passed. RUN-20261010-007 test:documentation failed when the WSL wall clock stepped back about 2.3 s mid-run (wall 3448 ms vs monotonic 5760 ms): one timing test saw clock_changed instead of timeout, and the recorder failed the run. Preserved unchanged; no test or validator was altered. After confirming 0 ms drift, RUN-20261010-008 reran the same suite on unchanged source and passed. RUN-20261010-009 docs:check passed after the handoff/evidence updates.
